install: Place sampler.html and the test folder together under clipsesh/sampler. No companion JavaScript, CSS, service worker, build step, or backend is required.
dataContract: Test cases pin session bytes by MD5. Session JSON contains audio dependency MD5s and URLs; recipe contains chop points, notes, automation and control/effect configs.
offline: Open this deployment ZIP using Open test bundle inside the sampler.
engineeringChecks: Open the test sidebar, expand Engineering checks & file format, then Run engineering checks. Requires the supplied fixture catalog.

validation.runtime: Native Chrome 151 on clipsesh.com; supplementary DOM emulation and software Web Audio checks.
validation.reportScope: All 40 embedded engineering checks and all seven canonical cases rerun in native Chrome for this HTML. Software integration checks passed. Historical strict musical failures are retained in native-chrome-before-threshold.json.
validation.musicalStatus: 70% rhythm similarity is the requested acceptance criterion. The audio reconstruction itself is unchanged.
validation.audition: Live A/B switch, automatic grid-page following, active notes, source chop marker, FX panel, and Stop verified through Chrome UI.
validation.assets: All seven session MD5s and 22 dependencies are unchanged. Only the musical acceptance limits in the catalog changed.

automationPanel: Click FX / AUTOMATION beside Play and Stop in the main sequencer. The panel shows delay/reverb settings and both automation lanes for the loaded arrangement. Before loading an arrangement it offers Open Sessions. Visibility is saved as workspace.automationOpen; the sound recipe is unaffected.
playback: In the test sidebar choose Audition A/B, then Run selected or Run all. HEAR B · REFERENCE and HEAR A · RECONSTRUCTION switch synchronized sides. PLAY A/B replays the loaded case. STOP AUDITION cancels a running queue. Silent checks measures without playback. The main grid shows exact arrangement hit positions; edit notes in the hit table.

similarityTarget.definition: 100 × nonnegative Pearson correlation of aligned 10 ms stereo RMS envelopes. It measures rhythmic intensity over time, not waveform or perceptual identity.
similarityTarget.editor: Load a musical case, edit Rhythm similarity target (%), then run it. Export test bundle persists the edited target for that case. Reloading the catalog resets unsaved overrides.
similarityTarget.guards: Musical cases still require matching sample rate, length and channel count and no more than 1 dB loudness difference. Mechanical cases keep strict waveform limits.
